title: The opening line of Proposition10 equates IPC membership with a frame class being universal.
details: Printed p.27 (PDF p.29), Proposition10 begins its proof with φ∈IPC ⇔ C=the set of all intuitionistic Kripke frames. For example φ=(p→p) is an IPC theorem even when C contains only the singleton frame, so this equivalence is false. The needed inference is simply that IPC soundness implies IPC⊆Log(C) for every nonempty frame class C. The subsequent substitution-model argument is unaffected. The corpus supplies the direct soundness argument and does not adopt the malformed equivalence; no claim about arbitrary intermediate-logic completeness follows from this proposition alone.
